blocks.text: Cell mein sab se zyada milne wale organic compounds proteins hain. Inhein amino acids ke polymers keh sakte hain. Proteins ko cell ke sab se aham (principal) compounds mana jata hai. J. J. Berzelius ne 1838 mein lafz “protein” banaya (Greek “Proteios”: pehle darje ke molecules), taake in macromolecules ki ahmiyat wazeh ho. Proteins cells aur jandaron ki structure ke liye zaroori hain aur un ke har kaam mein hissa lete hain. Is tarah yeh zindagi ke building blocks (bunyadi eentein) hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Berzelius ka saal 1938 likha hai. Sahi saal 1838 hai; Berzelius ka inteqal 1848 mein ho gaya tha.
Jandaron ki duniya mein jo itni rangarangi (diversity) hai, woh asal mein proteins ki structure aur kaam ki rangarangi ka aks (reflection) hai.
Structure of proteins (proteins ki banawat)

Proteins woh polymers hain jo amino acids naam ke monomers ke aapas mein jurne se bante hain. Mukhtalif proteins mein chand se le kar 3000 tak amino acids ho sakte hain (maslan insulin mein 51 amino acids, haemoglobin mein 574 amino acids).
Amino acid

Amino acid proteins ki bunyadi structural unit hai. Yeh aisa organic molecule hai jis mein chaar groups, yani amino group (NH₂), carboxyl group (COOH), hydrogen (H) aur side group (R), ek hi carbon atom se jure hote hain. Is carbon ko alpha carbon kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Beech mein alpha carbon jo chaar groups se jura hai: baayen H2N (amino group), daayen COOH (carboxyl group), upar R (side group) aur neeche H.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.23: Amino acid ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Qudrat mein bohat se amino acids milte hain; jandaron (cells aur tissues) mein taqreeban 170 qisam ke amino acids paye gaye hain. In mein se taqreeban 25 qisam proteins ki building units ban sakti hain. Magar zyada tar proteins sirf 20 qisam ke amino acids se bane hote hain.

Har amino acid ki pehchan aur us ki khaas chemical properties us ke side group (R) se tay hoti hain, jo alpha carbon se covalent bond se jura hota hai. Maslan glycine mein R sirf ek hydrogen atom hai, alanine mein CH₃ hai, aur doosre amino acids mein koi aur group (Figure 4.24).

blocks.alt: Do amino acids saath saath: glycine (hara), jis ke beech wale carbon par H2N, COOH, H aur H (R = H); aur alanine (neela), jis ke carbon par H2N, COOH, CH3 aur H (R = CH3).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.24: Glycine aur alanine ki aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Essential aur non-essential amino acids

20 amino acids mein se 11 hamara jism khud bana sakta hai. Inhein non-essential amino acids (jo khuraak se lena lazmi nahin) kehte hain: alanine, arginine, asparagine, aspartic acid, cysteine, glutamic acid, glutamine, glycine, proline, serine aur tyrosine. Baqi 9 amino acids hamara jism khud nahin bana sakta, is liye yeh mukhtalif khane khaa kar hasil karne parte hain. Inhein essential amino acids (lazmi amino acids) kehte hain: methionine, valine, tryptophan, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, threonine, phenylalanine aur histidine (kitab ke mutabiq sirf bachon ke liye zaroori).

Do amino acids ko jorne wale covalent bond ko peptide bond kehte hain. Yaad rakhein ke har amino acid ke ek sire par amino group aur doosre sire par carboxyl group hota hai. Jab do amino acids qareeb aate hain to ek ke amino group aur doosre ke carboxyl group ke darmiyan dehydration synthesis hoti hai. Is se pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai aur saath wale amino acids ke “N” aur “C” ke darmiyan peptide bond ban jata hai.
Disaccharide ki tarah dipeptide ka banna bhi dehydration synthesis hai.
Peptide bond se jure amino acids ko peptides kehte hain. Do amino acids ke jurne se dipeptide banta hai. Maslan glycine aur alanine ke jurne se glycylalanine (ek dipeptide) banta hai (Figure 4.25).

blocks.alt: Glycine + Alanine; neeche teer, H2O nikalta hai aur glycylalanine banta hai: H2N-CH2-C(=O)-N(H)-CH(CH3)-COOH; C(=O) hissa hara (glycine se) aur N-H hissa neela (alanine se), un ke darmiyan laal C-N bond par label Peptide bond. Labels: Glycine, Alanine, H2O, Glycylalanine, Peptide bond.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.25: Glycine aur alanine ke darmiyan peptide bond ka banna (kitab ki Figure 4.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Glycine ke COOH group se OH aur alanine ke H₂N group se ek H nikal kar pani (H₂O) bante hain. Bache hue C (glycine ka) aur N (alanine ka) aapas mein jur jate hain: yahi laal C-N bond peptide bond hai. Naye molecule ke ek sire par ab bhi H₂N aur doosre par COOH hai, is liye aur amino acids jur sakte hain.

Dipeptide ke ek sire par ab bhi amino group aur doosre sire par carboxyl group hota hai, is liye dono sire mazeed peptide bonds bana sakte hain. Amino acids judte jate hain aur aakhir mein polypeptide chains (lambi zanjeerein) ban jati hain (Figure 4.26). Ek protein ek ya zyada polypeptide chains se bana hota hai: maslan insulin mein do polypeptide chains hain aur haemoglobin mein chaar. Amino acids ki tadaad, qisam aur sequence (tarteeb) ke hisaab se polypeptide chains mukhtalif shaklein le leti hain. Isi se proteins ki structure ke mukhtalif levels (darjay) bante hain.

blocks.alt: Zanjeer H2N-C-C-N-C-C-N-C-C-N-C-COOH: har alpha carbon par upar R aur neeche H, har carbonyl carbon par upar double bond wala O, har N par upar H; pehle carbonyl carbon aur agle N ke darmiyan C-N bond par label Peptide bond.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.26: Polypeptide zanjeer ka ek hissa (kitab ki Figure 4.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Structural levels of proteins (protein structure ke darjay)

Proteins saada bhi hote hain (jo amino acids ki seedhi zanjeeron par mushtamil hain) aur complex bhi (jin ki seedhi zanjeeron mein mazeed structural tabdeeliyan hoti hain). Proteins in darjon (levels) par bante hain (Figure 4.29).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan “(Figure 4.27)” likhti hai, magar protein structure ke darjay Figure 4.29 mein dikhaye gaye hain; Figure 4.27 insulin ki chains dikhati hai.
Primary structure

Protein ki primary structure amino acids ki seedhi (linear) tarteeb se banti hai. Yeh batati hai ke polypeptide chain mein kitne amino acids hain aur kis sequence (tarteeb) mein hain. Har protein molecule (saada ho ya complex) ki apni khaas primary structure hoti hai. Insulin ki primary structure batati hai ke yeh do polypeptide chains se bana hai: chhoti alpha chain mein 21 amino acids aur lambi beta chain mein 30 amino acids hain (Figure 4.27).
Insani jism mein 10,000 se zyada proteins hain, aur har ek ki apni khaas primary structure hai, yani amino acids ki khaas tadaad, khaas sequence aur khaas qismein.

blocks.alt: Motiyon ki do zanjeerein: upar A chain (21 laal motiyan) aur neeche lambi B chain (30 hari motiyan) jo aakhir mein murti hai. Cysteine motiyon par Cys likha hai; dashed S-S bonds A chain ke andar A6 ko A11 se, aur dono zanjeeron mein A7 ko B7 aur A20 ko B19 se jorte hain. Legend: S-S bonds, A Chain, B Chain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.27: Insulin ki zanjeerein (kitab ki Figure 4.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Isi tarah haemoglobin ki primary structure batati hai ke yeh chaar polypeptide chains se bana hai: do alpha chains (har ek mein 141 amino acids) aur do beta chains (har ek mein 146 amino acids).

Protein ke theek kaam karne ke liye us ki primary structure mein amino acids ki tadaad, sequence aur qismein bilkul khaas (specific) hoti hain. Yeh khaas tarteeb DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb se tay hoti hai. Is mein koi bhi tabdeeli ghair-mamooli (abnormal) protein banati hai jo apna aam kaam nahin kar pata. Maslan sickle cell haemoglobin har beta chain mein jagah number chhe (position 6) par sirf ek amino acid ki ghalti se banta hai: wahan glutamic acid ki jagah valine aa jata hai. Is haemoglobin ki wajah se red blood cells darranti (sickle) jaisi shakal le lete hain aur yeh ghair-mamooli haemoglobin kafi oxygen nahin le ja sakta. Is beemari ko sickle cell anaemia kehte hain (Figure 4.28).

blocks.alt: Saat jure khaanon ki do qataarein. Normal haemoglobin: Valine, Histidine, Leucine, Threonine, Proline, Glutamic acid, Glutamic acid, aur teer gol normal red blood cell ki taraf. Sickle cell haemoglobin: wahi tarteeb magar chhata khaana Valine (roshan), aur teer darranti (sickle) jaise red blood cell ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.28: Normal aur sickle cell haemoglobin mein amino acid tarteeb ka farq (kitab ki Figure 4.28 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Secondary structure

Bohat se proteins mein polypeptide chain apne andar hi lipat (coil) jati hai ya tah (fold) ho jati hai; is ko secondary structure kehte hain. Chain ke lipatne se alpha helix (spring jaisi kundli) banti hai aur tah hone se pleated sheet (tahdar chadar). Dono shaklein chain mein qareeb wale amino acids ke amino aur carboxyl groups ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se qaim rehti hain.
Tertiary structure

Jab secondary structure mazeed tah ho kar ek pecheeda gol (globular) shakal ikhtiyar kar leti hai to isay protein ki tertiary structure kehte hain. Yeh zyada complex proteins hain. Yeh gol shakal ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim rehti hai. Yeh bonds protein ki stability (mazbooti) aur shakal mein hissa dalte hain.

Polypeptide chain ke amino acids pani ke saath interact kar ke sab se stable tertiary structure, yani gol shakal, banate hain. Yeh hydrophilic aur hydrophobic interactions hain. Hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids aise ikatthe hote hain ke pani ke molecules ki hydrogen bonding mein khalal dalte hain, is liye yeh protein ke andar chhup jate hain. Saath hi hydrophilic (polar) amino acids bahar, pani ki taraf mur jate hain.
Quaternary structure

Jab tertiary structure wali do ya zyada polypeptide chains hydrophobic interactions, hydrogen bonds aur ionic bonds se aapas mein jur jati hain to sab se complex proteins bante hain. Tertiary structures ke is majmuay (aggregation) ko protein ki quaternary structure kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Primary structure (amino acid motiyon ki zanjeer) -> secondary structure, alpha helix aur pleated sheet -> tertiary structure (mur kar lipti zanjeer jis mein helix aur sheet hain) -> quaternary structure (chaar lipti zanjeerein aapas mein juri), teeron se jure. Labels mein yahi naam hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.29: Protein ki banawat ki satahein (kitab ki Figure 4.29 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ke saath chalein. Pehle amino acids ki seedhi zanjeer (primary). Yeh zanjeer hydrogen bonds se kundli (alpha helix) ya tah-dar chadar (pleated sheet) banati hai (secondary). Phir poori zanjeer mur kar gol shakal leti hai (tertiary). Jab aisi do ya zyada zanjeerein mil jayen, jaise haemoglobin ki chaar, to quaternary structure banta hai.
Classification of proteins (proteins ki qismein)

Jandaron mein proteins organic compounds ka bohat mukhtalif (diverse) group hain. Inhein mukhtalif bunyadon par baanta ja sakta hai. Maslan jandar mein kaam ke hisaab se yeh “structural proteins” aur “functional proteins” hain. Magar tajweez kardah (recommended) classification structure par mabni hai, jis mein proteins ko “fibrous proteins” (reshedar) aur “globular proteins” (gol) mein baanta jata hai. Dono ki khususiyaat ka muqabla Table 4.4 mein hai.

blocks.text: Role of proteins in life (zindagi mein proteins ka kaam)
Jandaron ke taqreeban saare kaam proteins hi karte hain. In ke kuch numayan structural aur functional kaam yeh hain:

items: Proteins tamam plasma membranes (cell ki bahari jhilli) ka aham hissa hain.

Cell membranes ke channel proteins cells ke andar aur bahar cheezon ki aamad-o-raft control karte hain. Maslan neurons (nerve cells) ki cell membrane mein proteins sodium–potassium pump banate hain, jo nerve cell ke andar aur bahar Na⁺ aur K⁺ ions ki harkat control karta hai.
Kuch fibrous proteins, jaise collagen aur keratin, bil-tarteeb cartilage (narm haddi) aur baal, nakhun ki taqreeban poori structure banate hain.

Enzymes proteins ki woh qisam hain jo cells ke metabolism ko catalyse (tez) karte hain. Yeh bohat mukhtalif qisam ke hote hain; maslan proteases proteins ko torne aur polymerases polymers banane ka amal tez karte hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Collagen: teen motiyon ki lariyan (laal, hari, neeli) ek doosre ke gird lipat kar lamba seedha resha banati hain. (b) Haemoglobin: chaar lipti zanjeerein, do laal aur do peeli, aapas mein ghut kar gol (globular) shakal banati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.30: (a) Collagen, resha-dar (fibrous) protein; (b) haemoglobin, golai-numa (globular) protein (kitab ki Figure 4.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Nau khaane: Tubulin in spindle (motiyon ke chhallon ki nali); Channel proteins in plasma membrane (lipid bilayer ke aar paar protein ka raasta); Repressor protein attached with gene (DNA par protein); Fibrinogen activated into fibrin and making clot (fibrin ke dhaage RBCs pakarte hain); Myoglobin; Haemoglobin; Casein and ions in milk; Keratin found in hair and nails; Actin (yellow/red), myosin (blue) in muscle cell.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.31: Insani jism ke mukhtalif proteins (kitab ki Figure 4.31 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Janwaron ke kuch bohat aham hormones proteins ya peptides hain: insulin (khoon mein glucose ki miqdar control karta hai), antidiuretic hormone (gurdon mein pani rokne ko barhata hai) aur oxytocin (doodh ki paidawar control karta hai).

Kuch globular proteins jism mein mukhtalif cheezein le jate hain: haemoglobin aur myoglobin O₂ aur kuch CO₂ le jate hain, aur cytochromes electron transport chain mein electrons le jane ka kaam karte hain.
Albumin khoon ka protein hai jo khoon ki osmotic concentration qaim rakhta hai aur khoon ko behne ke qabil rakhta hai.

Chot lagne ke baad khoon zaya hone se bachane ke liye khoon ka jamna (clotting) zaroori hai. Khoon mein fibrinogen protein hota hai. Chot lagne par fibrinogen fibrin mein badal jata hai; fibrin reshe banata hai aur lothra (clot) ban jata hai.

Zinda maadde mein har qisam ka sukarna (contraction) proteins ki wajah se hai. Maslan actin aur myosin muscles ke bunyadi proteins hain aur muscles ke sukarne ke zimmedar hain. Tubulin protein spindle fibres banata hai.
Antibodies aham proteins hain. Yeh bahar se aane wali cheezon (antigens) ko pehchan kar un se jur jati hain aur unhein be-zarar bana deti hain.

Kuch ion-binding proteins jism ke mukhtalif hisson mein ions jama karte hain. Maslan ferritin cell ke andar iron (loha) jama karne wala bunyadi protein hai, aur casein doodh ka protein hai jo potassium aur calcium ions jama karta hai.
Repressors woh proteins hain jo RNA banne ko rok kar genes ka kaam control karte hain. Yeh genes ko sirf wahan aur tab kaam karne dete hain jahan aur jab zaroorat ho.

blocks.text: Mareezon mein anaemia (khoon ki kami) ki tashkhees ke liye khoon mein ferritin ki miqdar napi jati hai. Ferritin zyada ho to jism mein iron zyada hai; kam ho to iron ki kami ka khatra hai, jo der saweer anaemia ka sabab ban sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Haemoglobin ki beta chain ke 146 amino acids mein se sirf ek ghalat amino acid sickle cell anaemia paida karta hai. Protein structure ke darjon se samjhayein ke itni chhoti tabdeeli itni aham kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Primary sequence hi tay karti hai ke chain kaise lipategi aur tah hogi: side groups batate hain ke kaun se hisse hydrophobic ya hydrophilic hain aur kaun se bonds banenge. Position 6 par polar glutamic acid ki jagah non-polar valine aane se tah hui chain ki bahari satah badal jati hai; is liye haemoglobin molecules aapas mein chipak jate hain, red blood cell darranti jaisa ho jata hai aur kam oxygen le jata hai. Protein ka kaam us ki 3D shakal par, aur shakal sequence par depend karti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Proteins amino acids ke polymers aur cell ke sab se zyada milne wale organic compounds hain (Berzelius, 1838: “proteios”). Amino acid ke alpha carbon par NH₂, COOH, H aur R hote hain; R pehchan deta hai. Zyada tar proteins 20 amino acids se bante hain: 11 non-essential, 9 essential (khuraak se).

Peptide bond ek amino acid ke amino group aur doosre ke carboxyl group ke darmiyan dehydration synthesis se banta hai; dipeptide → polypeptide. Insulin: 2 chains (21 aur 30); haemoglobin: 4 chains (141, 141, 146, 146).

Darjay: primary (sequence, DNA se tay; sickle cell: position 6 par glutamic acid ki jagah valine), secondary (alpha helix, pleated sheet; hydrogen bonds), tertiary (globular; ionic, hydrogen, disulphide bonds; hydrophobic andar), quaternary (kai chains mil kar).

Fibrous proteins: structural, hal nahin hote, primary ya secondary (silk, keratin, collagen, fibrin, actin). Globular proteins: functional, hal hote hain, tertiary ya quaternary (enzymes, antibodies, hormones, haemoglobin).

Kaam: membranes aur pumps, structure, enzymes, hormones, transport, albumin, clotting (fibrinogen → fibrin), contraction (actin, myosin, tubulin), antibodies, ions jama karna (ferritin, casein), repressors.
